A '''wooden shovel''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], crafted from [[Planks|planks]]. It mines at speed 2 and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/wood/shovel</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines shovel blocks at speed 2.

=== Combat ===

It deals 2.5 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
